whatsappMessage:
Hi Team Glam & Beauty Salon,

I noticed your salon has amazing 4.8★ reviews in Kadamkuan, Patna, but your current site oddly lists "Hair Transplantation Clinic" as the header while you actually offer bridal makeup and skincare!

Maine aapke salon ke liye ek custom live website concept design kiya hai — jisme correct beauty menu, direct WhatsApp appointment booking, aur photo gallery integrate ki hai:

🔗 https://www.arclanestudios.space/sites/glambeauty

Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Would love your honest feedback!

— Ameya Sharma, Arclane Studios
callScript: "Hi Glam & Beauty Salon team, Ameya here from Arclane Studios. Maine aapke business ke liye ek custom live website concept banakar WhatsApp par share kiya tha. Bas ek minute check karna tha ki kya aapko link receive hua? Aur ek cheez notice ki thi ki purane site par galti se 'Hair transplantation' likha hua tha jabki aapka salon bridal makeup aur skincare ke liye Kadamkuan mein famous hai! Humne naye demo mein sabhi beauty services properly showcase ki hain. Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga?"
